source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: Source-proof defects are recorded separately from formalization gaps. Normal coverage is restricted to paper-facing mathematical definitions and named theoretical results.

llm_statement_review.policy: Compare the 42 closed Spec/proof declarations with the 21 byte-pinned source items by elaborated binders, expanded predicates, full action domains, and complete endpoints. Names are locators only and never semantic evidence.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Normal coverage is the complete source-only inventory of eleven paper-facing mathematical definitions and ten named results. Algorithms, examples, computational notation, proof-local notation, and ordinary extension prose are deep-only or support material.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Classify every recursive premise and terminal from expanded mathematical content. Do not infer source status from record, field, theorem, or function names.

semantic_model_review.policy: Review every expanded paper-facing model, procedure, and theorem surface semantically against the pinned source. Inspect the balanced finite carriers, complete one-to-one outcomes, strict ordinal rankings, numeric outside-option encoding, unilateral report domains, and every existence, optimality, incentive, and rank-manipulation endpoint. Record a dimension as not applicable only after inspecting its expanded semantics; declaration names are routing only.

v10_audit_state.reason: The 42-row Spec/proof surface has current v10 statement evidence and strict v11 source-to-Spec correspondence for all 21 normal source items. The single final raw audit has 227 current judgment groups bound by occurrence contracts to all 204 theorem-realization components, with zero unresolved source items, auxiliaries, recursive failures, or conclusion dependencies. Automated evidence does not imply human release certification.
